name: Evaluate medication safety and dosage suitability
description: Users asked for safety assessments, dosage clarifications, and compatibility checks for specific medications, supplements, or traditional remedies in the context of existing health conditions, comorbidities, or concurrent treatments. These requests primarily focused on determining appropriate dosing schedules, identifying drug interactions, and evaluating the suitability of specific therapeutic agents for individual patient scenarios.
